basic_info.description: Experience the best of San Francisco living in this rarely available northwest corner unit at Fontana East, a full-service luxury building in the heart of Russian Hill. This stunning co-op offers breathtaking, unobstructed views of the San Francisco Bay, Alcatraz, and the Golden Gate Bridge from the living room, dining area, primary suite, and kitchen.    Floor-to-ceiling sliding glass doors in the primary suite and living room open to a wraparound walkout terrace, where panoramic bay and mountain vistas create an unforgettable backdrop. The kitchen and second bedroom feature striking views of the city skyline.    Building amenities include a garden with barbecue facilities, a doorperson, 24-hour security, and on-site management.    Ideally located steps from Ghirardelli Square, Aquatic Park, and the vibrant shops and fine dining of Chestnut, Polk, and Union Streets  as well as North Beach  this residence offers the perfect blend of luxury, convenience, and iconic San Francisco charm.    Don't miss this rare opportunity to own a piece of San Francisco's most sought-after skyline!
